notes.title: Update 0.18.2.12
notes.content:
[list]
[*] threat indicators will now appear at the edges of the screen to indicate a general direction if the threat is out of view.
[*] torpedo indicator icon added to help with aiming at torpedoes.
[*] torpedo indicator range text made more transparent.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.18.2.11a
notes.content: torpedo explosion radius scaling lowered, larger torpedoes now have more going for them than just a bigger explosion.

notes.title: Recoil Update 0.18.2.11
notes.content:
[h3]Modules[/h3]
[list]
[*]  recoil added, everything you shoot out has recoil associated with it.
[*]  module masses varied up, previously all were 10.0 units base.
[*]  autocannon fire rate lowered about 33%, asteroid impact force halved and volume lowered 3db.
[*]  autocannon shells elongated so they're more easily seen.
[*]  autocannon and plasma cannon projectile origin points adjusted to be slightly farther back into the barrels so the trails connect a little better.
[*]  torpedo rate of fire adjusted to 1 : 10 grouping, turning rates improved over 100% and explosion force doubled.
[/list]
[h3]Drones[/h3]
[list]
[*]  minor performance improvements with indicators.
[*]  speed indicator color changes slowed down, giving rise to a yellow state of slowing down and speeding up simultaneously.
[*]  flight control retuning: roll correction is strongest when already aiming in the right direction to avoid unexpected backflips.
[*]  drone shield hitpoint regeneration rates doubled.
[*] 3 enemy designs updated to have more guns and more shields, be wary of more homing torpedoes around.
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]  torpedo homing quality became excessive up close, worse for larger torpedoes.
[*]  fire control code cleaned up to handle firing animations better with short refire intervals.
[/list]

notes.title: Balance Update 0.18.2.10
notes.content:
[list]
[*] autocannon damage reduced 25%.
[*] torpedo damage reduced 66%.
[*] fire animation duration for autocannon & torpedoes reduced to lowest possible to allow maximum fire rates.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.18.2.9c
notes.content:
[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] default master volume changed to 50% from 100%.
[*] explosion sfx now part of "Rumbles" set of audio; distance increased 25% and base volume lowered 3db.
[*] attenuation model for drone & weapon sounds changed to linear from inverse-distance - it should now be possible to hear incoming gunfire & nearby drones.
[*] drone engine sfx range changed to 2800m and made 2db quieter.
[*] autocannon shoot sfx range changed to 1800m.
[*] plasma cannon shoot sfx range changed to 2500m.
[/list]
[h3]Drones[/h3]
[list]
[*] enemy fire rate scaling reduced 50%.
[*] drone death explosion added, purple/magenta-colored.
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] convex hulls can sometimes run into precision issues when computing area, resulting in NaN drone stats and other problems.
[/list]

notes.title: Balance Hotfix 0.18.2.9b
notes.content:
[h3]Torpedoes[/h3]
[list]
[*] torpedo rotation dampening & angular acceleration increased 50%, scaling adjusted to be less varied across sizes.
[*] torpedo homing angles adjusted, small torpedoes need a 75-degree cone with large torpedoes having a 44-degree cone.
[*] torpedo braking forces lowered to 25% of thrust, brake ramp-down speed increased and ramp-up speed slightly decreased.
[*] torpedo detonation distance adjusted to 50m / 100m / 150m for small / medium / large respectively.
[*] torpedo damage scaling halved, small torpedo damage is conserved.
[*] torpedo base heat increased 200% as a cost of homing ability.
[/list]
[h3]Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*] enemy hitpoint scaling reduced 50%.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.18.2.9 - Homing Torpedoes
notes.content:
[h3]Torpedoes[/h3]
[list]
[*] torpedo trail made slightly more prominent.
[*] torpedo indicators simplified to colored distance markers only, for now.
[*] torpedo full acceleration now held for 75% of the travel phase.
[*] armed torpedoes will now thrust-vector towards drones they choose nearest to their line of sight.
[*] torpedo acceleration profile changed, larger torpedoes = longer ranged & faster.
[*] torpedo damage profile changed, large torpedoes will only do 2x more damage than smalls, roughly.
[*] torpedo rotational dampening has been greatly lowered, launch spin will matter a lot now.
[/list]
[h3]Camera[/h3]
[list]
[*] the camera chases the drone more closely now, should be harder to push the drone you're piloting off-camera.
[*] camera zoom step doubled, 4 zoom stages in & out now allowed.
[*] camera starting view angle increased 50%.
[/list]
[h3]Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*] enemy difficulty lowered considerably, reaching wave 5 should be attainable with most drone designs now.
[*] enemy designs now have shield boosters, greenhorn & yellowdog have been given more firepower.
[/list]
[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] bugfix: shield module wasn't correctly textured outside of the drone builder.
[*] bugfix: shield module selection hitbox in drone builder was too small.
[*] bugfix: shadow banding should be less frequent but unfortunately still present sometimes when a new world is generated - regenerating the world / starting another attempt usually fixes it, we're still looking into a permanent solution.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.18.2.8a
notes.content:
[list]
[*]  bugfix: minimum drone temperature wasn't taken into account during the simulation.
[*]  framerate counter added (check in Options to enable it).
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.18.2.8
notes.content:
[list]
[*] plasma cannon shoot sound added
[*] torpedo targeting indicators added
[*] 2 music tracks added
[*] heat glow amount halved, drones shouldn't be too bright when overheating anymore
[*] overheating isn't immediately fatal anymore and can be utilized strategically
[*] drone temperature now has a range
[*] explosion force vs drones doubled
[*] shield module now works as described, boosting hitpoints & stability at the cost of minimum temperature
[/list]
